law.description: Constitution, decision records, policy sources, glossary, and trace: the reference every other class is measured against.
law.constitution_authority: law/ — Architect (F1-law: constitution, register, ADRs, schemas, invariants, trace, policy sources; law/glossary/ joint with Owner)

spec.description: Invariants and schemas: the machine-checkable contracts under law/invariants/ and law/schemas/.

plan.description: Campaign and round plans, product records, and the machine-written record tree: intent and evidence, never behavior.
plan.constitution_authority: product/ — Owner (F1-business); record/ — machine only (record/derived/ by regeneration, record/proofs/ appended by executing verbs)

code.description: Package sources, package manifests, and package-local scripts and resources.
code.constitution_authority: packages/ and root workspace configuration — Engineer (F2)

tests.description: Test sources, fixtures, helpers, and test configuration under tests/ and packages/*/tests/.

docs.description: Published human documentation under docs/ and the root prose files.
docs.constitution_authority: docs/ — Architect (published human documentation); root prose files (README.md, CLAUDE.md, AGENTS.md) — Architect

ci.description: Workflows, repository hooks, repository automation scripts, and the test task descriptor that drives the local and remote gates.
ci.constitution_authority: Host-tool configuration directories (.changeset/, .claude/, and peers) — path fixed by the toolchain; contents classified per content class

toolchain.description: Root workspace configuration, lockfile, runtime and formatter pins, and vendored verifier bytes: dependency and runtime identity.
toolchain.constitution_authority: packages/ and root workspace configuration — Engineer (F2)

generated.description: Generated views of the action registry and the materialized policy and pin copies under .devai/: derived from canonical sources, never hand-edited.
generated.constitution_authority: .devai/pin/ and .devai/config/ — modified only through registered init apply or init bind actions, materialized from canonical package or policy sources; generated views under packages/ — Engineer (F2)

pairings.reason: The action registry under law/policy/action-registry.json and its generated views must co-commit, and a materialized policy copy under .devai/config must co-commit with the law policy it mirrors; a commit that carries one side alone leaves the generated side stale.
